milestone.title: Forgejo v18.0.0
milestone.description:
## Release notes - Security bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14811): 2026-10-12 security patches - Breaking security features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14148): Move internal communication to UNIX socket. The `INTERNAL_TOKEN` can now be dropped from the configuration, and the UNIX socket path can be configured using the `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PATH` options. This change removes the `./forgejo generate secret INTERNAL_TOKEN` command and updates the contrib Forgejo systemd unit file. The `forgejo.service` example systemd file has been updated to set `RuntimeDirectory=forgejo`, which is a recommended setting for all systemd users.
See the [documentation](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/#server-server) for more information. - User Interface features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14536): make dropdowns dialog-based with various improvements - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14467): improve admin notices, make notice detail modals work w/o JS - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13284): feat(admin): add menu to edit user quota groups - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14836): show num commits behind on pr merge box - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14559): feat(diff/lfs): show Git LFS labels, diffs & raw links in web UI correctly - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14910): hide escape/unescape button conditionally in gitdiff and blame - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14038): adds inline copy buttons for new repo instructions - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14425): allow users to preview fonts in the ui - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14299): add reload protection to file dropzone and code review comments - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14158): accessible aria-labels & working commit description toggles w/o JS - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14522): disable text wrapping in code blocks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13517): auth: start oauth2 login if its the only available login - User Interface bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14905): close project-column-edit modal after confirming - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14345): redirect loop on repo with tag but no branch - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14579): Add horizontal scrolling to code blocks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14435): Fix icons in milestone and project metadata not being consistent with how icons are used elsewhere on Forgejo - Localization - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14384): i18n: translations update from Codeberg Translate - Features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/11934): instance-wide Service Message via modal dialog - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14955): perf: improve performance of release & tag list pages - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14850): feat(api): reply to pull request review thread - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14204): add headings to common repository webpages - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14809): speedup `IsEmpty` check - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14386): feat(lfs): add lfs file support to /render endpoint - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14117): team membership provenance tracking - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14571): enh: add org members to other teams without invitation - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13023): add code suggestion - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14505): feat(feed): parse and set limit parameter for release feed request - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14164): feat(cmd): allow password to be read from stdin - Bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14849): made /user/two_factor redirect to login page - User Interface changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14598): sort user repositories in package linking, make input searchable - Other changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14621): deleting a user w/ repo-specific access tokens or authorized integrations causes foreign-key violation - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14703): use DB index when accessing API `GET /{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?head_sha=...` -
